items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: and we got to be good friends

ctx.x: I've worked with Ron. Yeah, I've played jobs with him.

(Unintelligible). And they had an excellent little bass player. You know, I can't think of that guy's name now. It's been so long. But, gee, he was a great little bass player. He was an excellent reader, and he helped me in quite a few ways during that time. There was a lot of things that, meeting people, and we got to be good friends, and there was a group that came through Denver one time wanting a bass player, and old silly me, I recommended him. They heard him, and they took him. And he's living right now in…

And we used to get off in the mornings and go and sip coffee somewhere and talk nothing but music, you know. And he introduced me to a lot of the musicians in Denver, and they used to come in and they'd sit in with us and jam. And a lot of times this particular club was the haven for musicians that would come in from out of town and couldn't sleep nights, you know. It ran pretty late, you know.
